nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm opaque RGBA16 WebP FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Resident original RGBA16 to complete independent VP8 WebP bytes with exact normalized alpha. Full source normalization and repacking included. Native codec/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused; RGBA-to-BGRA repacking and complete encode execute every operation.
